title: WhatsApp campaigns

ready.whatsapp: WhatsApp is not connected yet: add the token and the number ID in Message AI agent › Settings.
ready.waba: Add the WhatsApp Business account ID in Delivery AI agent › Settings, so Meta can approve your messages.

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.text: Send an offer on WhatsApp to past customers who said yes: a new product, a promo. They tap « I order » and Dellal takes the order.

act.startAsk: Launch « {{name}} »? Messages leave at your pace ({{perDay}} a day at most), never at night.
act.cancelAsk_one: Stop the campaign? The message left will not be sent.
act.cancelAsk_other: Stop the campaign? The {{count}} messages left will not be sent.

rejected: Meta rejected this message: {{why}}. Change the text, then send it again.
pending: Meta is checking this message (often a few minutes, sometimes up to 24 h). The campaign will be ready after that.

toast.approved: Message approved: the campaign is ready.

consent.title: Customers who accept offers
consent.form: Box ticked on the landing page
consent.boxHint: « I want to receive offers on WhatsApp », never ticked in advance.
consent.boxOn: The box is now on your landing pages.
consent.boxOff: The box is no longer on your landing pages.
consent.agents: Your agents can also tick « WhatsApp offers » in the order card when the customer says yes on the phone.

pace.title: Sending pace
pace.text: Never at night: nothing leaves between {{from}}:00 and {{to}}:00. A customer gets one campaign every 3 days at most.
pace.today_one: {{count}} message sent in the last 24 h.
pace.today_other: {{count}} messages sent in the last 24 h.
pace.meta: A new WhatsApp Business account can message 250 customers a day. Meta raises this limit when your messages are well received.

edit.readyNote: This message is already approved. If you change the text, the language or the buttons, it goes back to Meta.
edit.name: Campaign name
edit.countNone: Nobody yet: widen the choice, or add customers who accept offers.
edit.pbVar: Only the variables {nom} and {boutique} are allowed.
edit.pbEdge: Meta rejects a message that starts or ends with a variable: add a word before or after.
edit.pbShort: The message is too short (20 characters at least).
edit.pbLong: The message is too long (900 characters at most).
edit.productHint: When the customer taps « {{label}} », Dellal knows which product they mean.
edit.whenNow: As soon as it is launched
edit.whenNowHint: Messages leave at your pace, never at night.
edit.metaNote: Meta approves each new message once. The « Stop » button is always there: a customer who taps it gets no more offers.

results.ordersHint: An order counts when the customer orders within 7 days after the message.

import.title: Add numbers
import.rule: Add only customers who told you yes to receiving your offers on WhatsApp. Numbers Pilotix does not know are ignored.
import.label: One number per line
